summary: Iteration 13 — Bug fix verification: 'Visita' button not showing on kiosk success screen for Kleiver Herrera. All 5 backend pytest cases pass (test_kiosk_visit_flow.py). Frontend fix verified by code inspection of /app/frontend/src/pages/KioskScanPage.jsx (lines 251-278): (a) the 'if (marked === in)' gate was removed — the pending-visits query fires on BOTH in and out marks; (b) the local variable was renamed from 'pendingVisits' to 'visits' so it no longer shadows the state variable of the same name; (c) setPendingVisits(visits) is called when visits.length > 0, which triggers the JSX at line 544 to render the 'Visita' button with data-testid='kiosk-visit-btn'. When visits is empty, the setTimeout auto-close fires after 2.2s (regression preserved). Kiosk unlock UI loads with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: KioskScanPage.jsx is 987 lines and holds 4 sub-dialogs inline — consider extracting VisitSelfieDialog, PinPickerDialog, PinEnterDialog, ExitKioskDialog into /components for readability.

confirmMark: the 'Omitir por ahora' button at line 555 doesn't stop the camera scan interval; if user dismisses, the next detection cycle will re-open the match dialog immediately. Consider a small cooldown after success dismissal.
pending-visits endpoint is unauthenticated (matches kiosk pattern) but leaks visitor names/cedulas by host_user_id. Consider a short-lived kiosk session token.
server.py is 1913 lines — same recommendation as iter12: split into routers.
seed_data_creation: test_seed_pending_visit_if_missing creates a TEST_TestCo laboral visit with 2 TEST_Visitor entries for Kleiver at 12:00 UTC today only if none exists. Idempotent per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint GET /api/kiosk/pending-visits/{host_user_id} confirmed working (filters by scheduled_at today + status in [pending, in_progress], excludes _id and selfies). Attendance mark does NOT clear or affect pending-visits. Frontend confirmMark now queries pending-visits for both in/out marks and correctly sets state. Full E2E via Playwright is impractical because face-api.js requires real camera + registered descriptor; validated via code + API-level simulation instead.
rca_of_the_issue: Two independent frontend bugs prevented the 'Visita' button from appearing. (1) `if (marked === 'in') { ... }` wrapped the pending-visits fetch, so if the backend returned type='out' (Kleiver had already marked entry earlier) the fetch was skipped and pendingVisits state stayed []. (2) The response was assigned to a local `const pendingVisits = ...` inside confirmMark, shadowing the useState variable — `setPendingVisits(pendingVisits)` used the local variable value at that closure, but any subsequent read of pendingVisits state (in JSX) still saw the outer state that had never been updated in some code paths. Fix: remove the in/out gate and rename local var to `visits`. Verified by 5/5 pytest cases and by reading the fixed source at lines 262-274.
